summary: Perion Network Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing execution on November 1, 2026 of an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Affle 3IL Ltd. (Parent) and its wholly owned Israeli subsidiary Merger Sub, under which Merger Sub merges into Perion and Perion survives as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent — the US equivalent of a cash merger/take-private. Each ordinary share converts into US$11.70 cash, without interest and less withholding, subject to adjustment. The Board unanimously approved and resolved to recommend shareholder approval. Affle International Pte. Ltd. provided a guarantee, and Affle entities executed an equity commitment letter. Watch shareholder and Israeli Companies Law approvals, financing, and any superior proposal.
